subtasks.title: Add search state and input UI to KanbanBoard
subtasks.description: Add searchQuery state, a search input with magnifying glass icon and clear button above the board columns, and wire up client-side filtering against task.title and task.description.

subtasks.title: Add phase filter dropdown
subtasks.description: Add a multi-select dropdown to filter tasks by phase. Show a badge with active filter count. Filter stacks with search.

subtasks.title: Add source filter dropdown
subtasks.description: Add a dropdown to filter by task source (ideation, competitor-analysis, or all). Only show when tasks have source metadata.

subtasks.title: Add sort dropdown
subtasks.description: Add a sort dropdown with options: Newest first (default), Oldest first, A-Z, Z-A. Apply sorting after search/filter.

subtasks.title: Style and polish
subtasks.description: Match existing dark theme. Add proper icons, hover states, transitions. Ensure responsive layout of the filter bar.
